category_title: Low-achieving male vocational students with a preference for digital tasks over traditional writing
minimal_context: The student is using Photoshop to design a laptop flyer for a regular class assignment.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please open Photoshop and start working on your regular assignment to design a laptop flyer.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: There are too many menus and tools in this program. This looks really difficult to achieve.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just give it a try and see what you can do.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't know how to make it look right. These regular assignments make me get bored very quickly.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep trying, you need to finish the flyer today.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Closes the program) I'm not doing this. It's too difficult and I'm bored, so I'm just not going to participate.
